seo.title: ODD — ODDfest, ODDference & ODDspace | Helsinki
seo.description: ODD builds events, spaces and projects that strengthen creative work and bring creative and cultural expertise closer to business and wider society.

hero.mosaicAlt: People, performances, talks and encounters from ODD in Helsinki.

opening.headline: ODD exists to build better conditions for creative work — and to bring creative and cultural fields closer to business and wider society.

whatOddIs.headline: Finland has creative talent. It needs more structures that help it grow, connect and last.
whatOddIs.body:
Creative work in Finland is strong, but the support around it is often fragmented. Projects, funding, spaces, networks and partnerships exist — but they do not always connect in ways that make it easy for good work, relationships and opportunities to build on each other over time.

There is also still more potential in bringing creative and cultural expertise into closer contact with business, institutions and wider society. ODD creates places, events and projects where those connections can happen more naturally — while helping creative work find new audiences, partners and contexts.

twoWaysIn.intro: ODD brings two worlds together — creative and cultural people, and businesses that want to work with them.

creative.lede: Work, create and connect with other creatives.
creative.body: Work from ODDspace. Bring something of your own to ODDfest. Use the parts of ODD that are useful to your practice — without having to become part of a single scene or organisation.

business.lede: Get closer to creative expertise and the people behind it.
business.body: Come to ODDference, build a partnership, or bring us a brief that needs cultural understanding, creative expertise and people from more than one field.

proofIntro.headline: Two years in, this is what has already happened.
proofIntro.body: ODD began with the first ODDfest in 2025. Since then, ODDference and ODDspace have joined it, alongside project work with organisations. The figures below are cumulative across that work.

platforms.meta: Across Helsinki · Made by its hosts
platforms.title: ODDfest
platforms.body: Helsinki’s creative week, bringing independent events, ideas and creative communities across the city together into one shared week.

platforms.title: ODDference
platforms.body: A business conference powered by creative expertise — exploring what business and society can learn from the creative world.

platforms.title: ODDspace
platforms.body: A year-round home for creative work — bringing workspace, studios, events and community under one roof.

workWithOdd.title: Work with ODD
workWithOdd.body: Bring us a question, brief, event or partnership idea. We build the right team, format and creative expertise around it.
